title: 電気数学Ⅰ
subtitle: Mathematics for Electrical and Electronic Engineering I
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to learn the basic mathematics related to electrical and electronic engineering, and to acquire basic knowledge of electricity, such as electrical circuits, electromagnetism, and electronic circuits. The aim is also to cultivate the ability to apply this knowledge to specific problems through physical and mathematical considerations. This course is the basis for the subsequent “Mathematics for Electrical and Electronic Engineering Ⅱ” and “Electric Circuits I” courses.
advice:
Development of basic mathematical skills:
Students will learn about methods of solving linear simultaneous equations using substitution, addition and subtraction, and determinants, as well as basic functions (trigonometric ratios, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, logarithmic functions), complex numbers, and other topics that will be widely required in the future in the basic mathematics for  electrical and electronic Engineering.
books: A textbook written in Japanese will be used.
requiredKnowledge: This course is an introduction to the field of electrical and electronic engineering. It is important to review mathematics (simultaneous equations, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, etc.) learned in high school for future learning. It is desirable to study areas that were not taken in high school using self-study and learning support systems in our university.

activityGoals.body: To understand how to solve simultaneous equations using the substitution method, addition and subtraction method
To understand how to calculate basic functions
To understand how to describe and calculate complex numbers

              The aim of this course is to learn the basic mathematics related to electrical and electronic engineering, and to acquire basic knowledge of electricity, such as electrical circuits, electromagnetism, and electronic circuits. The aim is also to cultivate the ability to apply this knowledge to specific problems through physical and mathematical considerations. This course is the basis for the subsequent “Mathematics for Electrical and Electronic Engineering Ⅱ” and “Electric Circuits I” courses.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Development of basic mathematical skills:
Students will learn about methods of solving linear simultaneous equations using substitution, addition and subtraction, and determinants, as well as basic functions (trigonometric ratios, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, logarithmic functions), complex numbers, and other topics that will be widely required in the future in the basic mathematics for  electrical and electronic Engineering.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              A textbook written in Japanese will be used.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course is an introduction to the field of electrical and electronic engineering. It is important to review mathematics (simultaneous equations, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, etc.) learned in high school for future learning. It is desirable to study areas that were not taken in high school using self-study and learning support systems in our university.
